appropriate_uses: Defense-industrial-base analysis, inventory estimates, replenishment timelines, and cited budget or acquisition leads.
inappropriate_uses: Treating modeled or estimated inventories as disclosed official stockpile counts, or counting reporting that cites the same CSIS estimate as independent confirmation.
known_failure_modes: Expert modeling; opaque assumptions; reliance on public budget documents and unofficial estimates; policy framing may exceed disclosed data.
name: Center for Strategic and International Studies
observables: defense analysis, inventory estimates, procurement context, replenishment timelines
originating_chain_rule: CSIS reports, charts, and commentary based on the same named analysis or estimate remain one CSIS chain; outside reporting that cites CSIS inherits that estimate lineage for the cited figures.

review_history.note: Added for interceptor-stock and defense-industrial-base verification packets; expert-analysis limits recorded.
